steps.text:
WARNING - IMPORTANT NOTE: At any point a Diamond of Azzanadra is in your inventory, a level 95 Stranger may appear and attack you with a poisoned dragon dagger.

Talk to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp. You can use the flying carpet service from the Shantay Pass to get here.
Talk to the Terry Balando in the Exam Centre found south-east of Varrock, directly south of the Digsite.
choices: Ask about the Desert Treasure quest.

steps.text: Talk to the Terry Balando again.
choices: Ask about the Desert Treasure quest.

steps.text: Bring the translation to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp.
Talk to the Archaeologist again.
Unequip any god-related items you have on, or else you'll be attacked by bandits. Go buy a drink from the pub in the Bandit Camp, then talk to the Bartender again.
Talk to the bartender in the Bandit Camp again.
Talk to Eblis in the east of the Bandit Camp.
choices: Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra

steps.text: Use the items on Eblis in the east of the Bandit Camp. Items can be noted.
Talk to Eblis at the mirrors south east of the Bandit Camp.
Enter the smokey well west of Pollnivneach. You'll need to run a lot, so bring energy/stamina potions if you can.
Light all the torches in the corners of the dungeon. This is timed, so try to do it as fast as possible. Start with the north east torch, and work your way to the south west.
Light all the torches in the corners of the dungeon.
Light all the torches in the corners of the dungeon.
Light all the torches in the corners of the dungeon.
Open the chest in the middle of the dungeon.
Use the warm key on the gate in the east of the dungeon. Be prepared to fight Fareed. If you aren't wearing ice gloves he'll unequip your weapon.
Enter the gate in the east of the dungeon. Be prepared to fight Fareed. If you aren't wearing ice gloves he'll unequip your weapon.
Kill Fareed. Either use melee with ice gloves, or water spells. Recall that the mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamond.
Talk to Rasolo south of Baxtorian Falls.
choices: Ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra

steps.text: Bring antipoison, food, and as many lockpicks as you can to the Bandit Camp, and try opening the chest in the south of the Bandit Camp. Keep trying until you succeed.
Talk to Malak in the pub in Canifis.
choices: I am looking for a special Diamond...

steps.text: Ask Malek in the pub in Canifis how to kill Dessous.
Return the cross to Rasolo south of Baxtorian Falls.
Equip the Ring of Visibility, then go down the ladder in the area east of Rasolo. It's recommended you bring combat gear to safe spot Damis.
Go to the far eastern room of the dungeon, and wait for Damis to spawn.
Kill both phases of Damis. You can safespot him by attacking a bat and keeping the bat between the two of you.
Kill both phases of Damis. You can safespot him by attacking a bat and keeping the bat between the two of you.
Pick up the shadow diamond. Recall that the mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamond.
Bring a silver bar to Ruantun in Draynor Sewer.
choices: Actually, I don't need to know anything.

steps.text: Bring a silver bar to Ruantun in Draynor Sewer.
Travel to Entrana with the silver pot and have the High Priest enchant it.
Bring the blessed pot to Malak in the pub in Canifis. He'll bite you for a small bit of damage.
Use the spice on the blessed pot.
Add the garlic powder to the blessed pot.
Add the garlic powder to the blessed pot.
Use the blessed pot on the vampyre tomb in the graveyard south east of Canifis. Be prepared to fight Dessous.
Kill Dessous.
Return to Malak in Canifis to get the Blood Diamond. Recall that the mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamond.
Use a cake on the Troll Child north of Trollheim.
Talk to the Troll Child north of Trollheim.
Enter the ice gate east of the troll child. Make sure you're prepared for combat, and your stats to be continually drained.
Kill 5 ice trolls.
Continue along the path through the cave to the east.
Continue along the path until you find Kamil. Kill him with fire spells. Get into melee distance and protect from melee.
Equip the spiked boots, then continue along the path until you reach an ice ledge. Climb up it.
Follow the Ice Path up to the top and enter the gate there.
Break the ice surrounding the trolls at the end of the path. Fire spells are effective for this.
Break the ice surrounding the trolls at the end of the path. Fire spells are effective for this.
Talk to the troll parents at the end of the Ice Path.
Talk to the Troll Child north of Trollheim to get the ice diamond. Recall that the mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamond.
Place all the diamonds in the obelisks around the pyramid south east of the Bandit Camp. Note a mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamonds.
Place all the diamonds in the obelisks around the pyramid south east of the Bandit Camp. Note a mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamonds.
Place all the diamonds in the obelisks around the pyramid south east of the Bandit Camp. Note a mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamonds.
Place all the diamonds in the obelisks around the pyramid south east of the Bandit Camp. Note a mysterious stranger can appear and attack you whilst you're holding the diamonds.
Bring any energy/stamina potions you have, some food, and enter the pyramid south east of the Bandit Camp.
Go down to the bottom of the pyramid. You may randomly fall out of the pyramid as you traverse it and need to start again.
Go down to the bottom of the pyramid.
Go down to the bottom of the pyramid.
Enter the central room of the bottom floor.
Talk to Azzanadra to finish the quest!
